item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description:
What's new in 1.5.0

  • Android apps now show their real icons. Traffic from a phone attached over adb used to fall back to coloured letter tiles. Moni Proxy now asks the device for each app's own launcher icon, so the sidebar and the app column look like your phone's home screen.
  • Protobuf responses are readable. A binary protobuf body used to be a wall of hex. It now renders as an indented field tree, so captions, IDs and URLs inside it are visible at a glance. Field names stay numeric — protobuf doesn't carry them on the wire without a .proto.
  • Gzipped JSON shows as JSON. Some servers label a gzipped JSON body as protobuf or octet-stream; those were hex-dumped even though they decoded cleanly. The body's actual bytes now decide, so mislabelled responses read properly while genuinely binary ones stay hex.
  • Save any response body. The Raw tab has Copy and Save body, writing the original bytes with an extension that matches the encoding — useful for payloads the app can't decode on its own.
  • Config gallery lists every config. A config published as a .config file was being filtered out of the gallery.
  • Also: deflate responses that use a real zlib header now decompress instead of falling back to raw bytes.
